name: job.redesign
description: REDESIGN JUDGE. Ranks candidate rewrites against an incumbent artifact. state = the incumbent text and its score vector, plus one or more candidate rewrites. Jev never writes: a separate text model produces candidates and this pack decides whether any replaces the incumbent. Discard any candidate that raises the mean by adding unverifiable prose.

fact_drift.instructions: Does the candidate add, drop, restate or move any number, employer, title, date, credential, technology or outcome relative to the incumbent? Any drift counts.

outcome_leads.instructions: How well the candidate's bullets lead with the business outcome
criteria: one bullet leads with an outcome
some bullets lead with an outcome
most bullets lead with an outcome and carry a number
every bullet leads with a measurable outcome at its original scope

regression_check.instructions: Compared with the incumbent, is the candidate better on the named weak questions without dropping on the questions that were already strong?

target_alignment_gain.instructions: How much the candidate closes the target-dependent gap against the live posting
criteria: one requirement now mirrored in the target's own words
the top two requirements mirrored with evidence beside them
the top three requirements mirrored and the summary names the target's mandate
every must-have mirrored and answered with a dated, quantified outcome

no_padding_for_the_scorer.instructions: Does the candidate add words, adjectives, duplicated requirements or restated claims whose only purpose is to raise this rubric's score rather than to inform a human reader?

rules.reason: the candidate altered a fact; a rewrite rearranges and emphasises, never invents
the candidate pads to raise the score; a higher mean bought with unverifiable prose is not improvement
the candidate regresses on a strong question; keep the incumbent

notes: Applied 2026-09-22 and it already caught one: a blackwell rewrite of 28 bullets scored 4.61 against the incumbent's 4.86 and was discarded. Deterministic first: the code token-diff (every number and proper noun must be present in both directions) is the primary fact-drift gate and runs before Jev sees anything; Jev's noul is the backstop for drift the token diff cannot see, such as restated scope. no_padding_for_the_scorer exists because the operating goal is a 9.5 mean and a 9.5 earned by padding is worse than a 4.9 honestly measured. Advisory while calibrated:false.
